passages.note: Bill details page names Mishler as a Senate sponsor of an omnibus 'various tax matters' bill.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Ryan Mishler, Sen. Travis Holdman, Sen. Lonnie Randolph.

passages.note: Roll call 374 shows Mishler voting Yea (50-0) on the conference committee report for the omnibus tax bill.

passages.provision_quote: (4) For taxable years beginning after December 31, 2022, and before January 1, 2025, three and fifteen hundredths percent (3.15%).
passages.note: Enrolled act text: the broad individual income-tax rate cut is one clause among many unrelated tax and non-tax provisions in this bill.

rows.reasoning: HB 1002 (2022) is an omnibus 'various tax matters' bill bundling a broad individual income-tax rate cut, a narrow mini-mill property-tax valuation carve-out, repeal of the utility receipts tax with related utility-rate and criminal-code cleanup, partnership audit procedures, cable franchise revenue rules, and an unrelated Medicaid managed-care reporting requirement (SECTION 18). Mishler's sponsorship and Yea vote on the conference committee report are multi-subject and prove direction at most; without his own statement tying the vote to the rate-cut clause specifically, no rung is established.
needs_source: Mishler's own statement, floor speech, or explanation of vote tying his sponsorship/Yea vote on HB 1002 (2022) specifically to the individual income-tax rate reduction (as opposed to the bill's other provisions), which V4.1 requires to prove a chair from a multi-subject bill.
